name: markhamrealtor-directory
description: SEO-first Markham realtor directory deployed to Cloudflare Pages.

scripts.build: rm -rf dist && mkdir -p dist/assets && node scripts/render.mjs && npx @tailwindcss/cli -i ./src/input.css -o ./dist/styles.css --minify && cp index.html realtors.json robots.txt sitemap.xml manifest.webmanifest 404.html _headers dist/ && cp -R assets/. dist/assets/
